output.reason: First-trimester bleeding heavier than spotting with lower abdominal cramping at about 8 weeks requires hands-on assessment today with ultrasound, hCG and exam to exclude ectopic pregnancy, which messaging cannot do.
output.patientMessage: Please be seen in person today at an emergency department or urgent early-pregnancy service. Bleeding heavier than spotting with cramping at 8 weeks needs an ultrasound, blood tests and exam to rule out an ectopic pregnancy. Call 911 or go immediately if you feel faint or dizzy, have severe or shoulder pain, or soak through a pad an hour. A Counsel clinician can help coordinate, but don't wait for a reply.
